description: Ordered evidence-source inventory for Alex Ford Adventures. Semantic layers describe provenance; loadOrder alone defines shallow-merge precedence. Official-result sources intentionally remain last so verified organizer/timer fields win without erasing underlying GPS evidence.

layerDefinitions.recovered: Records recovered or reconciled from Strava, historical archives, medals, GPX, and related evidence.
layerDefinitions.confirmed: User-confirmed or medal-confirmed records and corrections.
layerDefinitions.editorial: Curated adventure and accomplishment records that enrich the public narrative.
layerDefinitions.activity: Day-level activity/outings reconstructed from personal GPS evidence.
layerDefinitions.official: Organizer, timer, or user-supplied official result records with highest field precedence when verified.
